Name: SwimsuitsAnywhere
Author: Myzkatonic
Description:
Have you ever wanted your farmer to rock a swimsuit outside of the bathhouse? If so, you're in luck! This is a simple mod for Stardew Valley allowing players to toggle between normal clothes and swimsuits from anywhere on the map, designed to be simple, lightweight, and compatible with pretty much any other mods. It also contains an optional updated swimsuit sprite for your farmer if you're looking to step up your beach style. This is my first mod and I'm still learning the ropes, so if you have any feedback at all please let me know so I can keep learning and improving![b]

DISCLAMER:[/b] I checked the "skimpy outfits" content flag to avoid any trouble because the optional updated spritesheet includes some edits to the sprites' underwear and bikinis. However, this is all for aesthetic purposes to make the swimsuits look more realistic to a beach setting and I didn't intentionally make anything any more revealing than it originally is. Nothing in this mod is any less SFW than the base game itself. I'm planning on including less revealing swimsuit options in future versions for anyone who would prefer that style instead. 


[b]Features
[/b][list]
[*]Toggle between swimsuit and normal clothes anywhere on the map
[*]Set a customizable hotkey for changing into swimsuit (default is J)
[*]Optional updated assets for your swimsuit sprite
[*]More to come, such as new swimsuit styles, gender neutral options, and more!
[/list][b]
Installation[/b][list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download and unzip SwimsuitsAnywhere
[*]Move the unzipped SwimsuitsAnywhere folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder﻿
[/list]

[b]Configuration
[/b]On config.json you can configure the mod with the following options:[list]
[*]ChangeKey: The hotkey used to toggle in and out of swimsuits. (default = J)
[*]updateSprite: Toggle the updated spritesheet for this mod's custom swimsuit sprites. Set to "false" to disable. (default = true)
[/list]

[b]Compatibility
[/b]This mod should be compatible with any other mods. For other mods involving updated spritesheets for farmer bases or pants, you might need to set updatedSprite to false on config.json. Additionally, make sure that the hotkey for changing into swimsuits is set to a key that doesn't clash with any other mods' hotkeys.
